scientific_question: Can collaborative interleaved decoding replace the expensive capacity decoder without losing the original single-polynomial OPI objective?
input_model: Explicit p=3 mod4 quadratic-character OPI with fixed public shifts; c independent nonzero Fourier-value rows conditional on a common support; no IID input shifts
proposed_mechanism: Stack row syndromes, reconstruct common error locator, erase all row errors, separate Fourier readouts, select an original output polynomial
expected_upside_not_realized: Replace severe capacity-decoder exponents by polynomial-size collaborative field-linear recovery while retaining the known finite score
resource_requirements: cN error and cK syndrome registers with O(logp) bits; field-linear recurrence solve, root checks, Vandermonde reconstruction and full syndrome replay; scalable coherent gate compilation not supplied
executed_classical_result: p61,N127,K39,cap32: five/eight independent rows recover all errors; two rows and five repeated rows remain UNKNOWN; no source/support passed to decoder
local_rank_proof: For c(K-ell)>=ell, a degree-j nonzero minor polynomial gives failure mass<=ell/(p-1) on independent uniform Fp* row values, for every fixed support
local_quantum_rejection: All-support near-isometry, tensor polar comparison and pointwise predicate-square bounds make each original row nearly uniform; rank postselection separately charges failure and collision amplification
large_fixed_input_bound: At N127,K39,ell32,p61, each rank-heralded row is within3.726e-9 TV of uniform; best of five/eight reaches110/127 with probability<=1.863e-8/2.981e-8 under local proof
strongest_comparators: Correct single-copy finite DQI conditional lower tail0.314586 at110/127; saved classical same-input word109/127; no new matched runtime separation is claimed
falsifiers_and_scope: Actual rank recovery must use only syndromes and retain rank failures
Rank rejection mass must not be equated to genuine collision mass or blindly given M-fold amplification
All-support Gram uniformity, not merely radial norm control, is required
Uniform-polynomial tail bounds may use only K-wise-independent moments, not a full binomial law
Joint product correlation is not the original individual-polynomial score
General interleaving, new linear combinations, joint quantum readout, asymmetric sources and support-dependent feedforward are not ruled out
